``` python
    day:date

```

*htmx POST target for one checkbox.*

``` python
assert toggle_url("読書", date(2026, 8, 24)) == "/toggle/%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8/2026-08-24"
assert toggle_url("A?B", date(2026, 8, 24)) == "/toggle/A%3FB/2026-08-24"  # ? must not become a query
assert toggle_url("50%off#tag", date(2026, 8, 24)) == "/toggle/50%25off%23tag/2026-08-24"
```

### create_app

``` python
def create_app(
    data_path:Path, # ledger.csv location — outside the static route (DESIGN.md §3)
    password:str, # login password; must be non-empty
    secret_key:str, # session cookie signing key; must be non-empty
    https_only:bool=False, # sess_https_only — production sets this (DESIGN.md §6)
    default_items:list=['読書', '運動', '執筆', '瞑想', '早起き'], # columns for first-run auto-create
    tz:ZoneInfo=zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(key='Europe/Helsinki'), # timezone that defines "today"
    static_path:str='static', # dedicated assets dir; must not contain the ledger
):
```

*Build the habitrack FastHTML app; fails fast on empty secrets.*

``` python
# empty secrets must be rejected at startup, not silently accepted
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "ledger.csv"
    for pw, key in [("", "k"), ("pw", ""), ("", "")]:
        try:
            create_app(p, pw, key)
            assert False, "empty secret must be rejected"
        except ValueError:
            pass
```

``` python
# auth flow + toggle roundtrip against a temp ledger
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "ledger.csv"
    cli = Client(create_app(p, "pw", "k"))

    r = cli.get("/")  # unauthenticated -> login
    assert r.status_code == 303 and r.headers["location"] == "/login"
    assert cli.get("/login").status_code == 200

    r = cli.post("/login", data={"password": "wrong"})
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/login"
    r = cli.post("/login", data={"password": "pw"})
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/"

    r = cli.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200 and 'id="ledger"' in r.text

    t = datetime.now(TZ).date()
    item = DEFAULT_ITEMS[0]
    assert load_full(p, [], t).at[t, item] == False
    cli.post(toggle_url(item, t))
    assert load_full(p, [], t).at[t, item] == True
    cli.post(toggle_url(item, t))  # toggle back
    assert load_full(p, [], t).at[t, item] == False
```

``` python
# a hand-added item name with URL metacharacters works end to end
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "ledger.csv"
    p.write_text("date,A?B\n2026-08-23,False\n")
    cli = Client(create_app(p, "pw", "k"))
    cli.post("/login", data={"password": "pw"})
    day = date(2026, 8, 23)
    cli.post(toggle_url("A?B", day))
    assert load_full(p, [], day).at[day, "A?B"] == True
    assert "/toggle/A%3FB/" in cli.get("/").text  # rendered checkboxes carry the encoded URL
```

``` python
# an archived item (~ prefix) renders last, struck through, read-only, and ignores /toggle
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "ledger.csv"
    p.write_text("date,~古い,新しい\n2026-08-23,True,False\n")
    cli = Client(create_app(p, "pw", "k"))
    cli.post("/login", data={"password": "pw"})
    html = cli.get("/").text
    assert html.index("新しい") < html.index("古い</s>")  # archived row moved to the bottom
    assert "disabled" in html and "/toggle/%7E" not in html  # no htmx target on archived boxes
    day = date(2026, 8, 23)
    cli.post(toggle_url("~古い", day))
    assert load_full(p, [], day).at[day, "~古い"] == True  # unchanged
```

``` python
# badge = checked days in the trailing 30 days, as n/30; a miss does not reset it
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "ledger.csv"
    t = datetime.now(TZ).date()
    days = [t - timedelta(days=i) for i in (1, 3, 31)]  # 31 days ago is outside the window
    p.write_text("date,x\n" + "".join(f"{day.isoformat()},True\n" for day in sorted(days)))
    cli = Client(create_app(p, "pw", "k"))
    cli.post("/login", data={"password": "pw"})
    assert '<span class="count">2/30</span>' in cli.get("/").text
```

``` python
# click-to-edit rename; a leading ~ archives, removing it restores; invalid names re-render the form with the error
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = Path(d) / "ledger.csv"
    p.write_text("date,読書\n2026-08-23,True\n")
    cli = Client(create_app(p, "pw", "k"))
    cli.post("/login", data={"password": "pw"})
    header = lambda: p.read_text().splitlines()[0]

    assert 'hx-get="/edit/%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8"' in cli.get("/").text  # the name is clickable
    r = cli.get("/edit/%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8").text
    assert 'value="読書"' in r and 'hx-post="/rename/%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8"' in r

    assert 'id="ledger"' in cli.post("/rename/%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8", data={"new": "本"}).text
    assert header() == "date,本"
    cli.post("/rename/%E6%9C%AC", data={"new": "~本"})  # archive by typing ~
    assert header() == "date,~本"
    r = cli.get("/edit/%7E%E6%9C%AC").text
    assert 'value="~本"' in r  # archived row shows its marker
    cli.post("/rename/%7E%E6%9C%AC", data={"new": "~読書"})  # rename while archived stays archived
    assert header() == "date,~読書"
    cli.post("/rename/%7E%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8", data={"new": "読書"})  # restore by removing ~
    assert header() == "date,読書"

    r = cli.post("/rename/%E8%AA%AD%E6%9B%B8", data={"new": "a/b"}).text
    assert "forbidden" in r and 'value="a/b"' in r and header() == "date,読書"  # error shown, file untouched
    assert p.read_text().count("\n") == 2  # history row still there
```
